scope: AUD-9 regression: keep plain query-plan output masked for read-scoped agents

reproduction.observed: The full PostgreSQL release fixture failed twice after PR #456 because plain EXPLAIN output was fully redacted; review determined the redaction is the safe behavior because plans can disclose server-generated predicates.

fix: Keep all EXPLAIN plan rows masked when lineage is unknown. The release test now requires a read-scoped agent to receive no plan details, and the MCP tool description documents that behavior.
